description.value:
Pure terror requires only the most basic processing. When you already know I want to scare you but I still manage to scare you, then that's skill.

"Aha! The fact remains, jump scares will always be the ace up the sleeve in the realm of horror."

D&D 5e Effect

As an action, consume this item and choose the creatures in your Main Party who can see you. In the next combat, the GM secretly chooses one creature. At the start of its turn the box explodes: creatures within 10 feet make a DC 14 Dexterity save, taking 4d6 force damage on a failure or half on a success. A creature can benefit from only one synthesized pre-combat consumable at a time; a new one replaces the previous one.

GM Description — Original HSR Effect

In the next battle after use, Scare Box will hide on a random unit and explode at the start of the turn, dealing massive DMG.
